meta.title: 婚纱照修图进行中、修图过程

scenes.context: 开场侧脸：发顶到额头的勾勒线，圆形播放式光标停在发际附近。修图师从脸部轮廓入手，先用钢笔勾勒关键线条。
sentences: 从发顶到额头勾勒线条。
An outline runs from the crown to the forehead.
The cursor pauses at the hairline.
scenes.speak: An outline runs from the crown to the forehead. The cursor pauses at the hairline.

scenes.context: 天空选区：不规则「蚂蚁线」落在蓝天区域，准备做局部处理或填充。用选区工具圈出天空，准备替换或调整。
sentences: Marching ants trace the blue sky.
准备做局部处理或填充。
Ready for local edits or a fill.
scenes.speak: Marching ants trace the blue sky. Ready for local edits or a fill.

scenes.context: 液化/变形网格：新娘全身三角网与钉点，耳旁显示像素坐标与6.0°。液化工具通过网格精确控制身体曲线，避免全局变形。
sentences: A full-body triangle mesh with pins.
液化精确调整身体曲线。
Liquify shapes the body line precisely.
scenes.speak: A full-body triangle mesh with pins. Liquify shapes the body line precisely.

scenes.context: 西服选区：蚂蚁线贴着夹克下摆与背景交界，准备局部处理。沿服装边缘建立选区，为局部调整做准备。
sentences: Marching ants ride the jacket hem.
scenes.speak: Marching ants ride the jacket hem. Ready for local adjustment.

scenes.context: 肩部变形网格：蓝色3×3锚点覆盖西装肩臂，水印「颜值修图」可见。针对肩臂区域做局部网格变形，调整体态。
sentences: Blue 3×3 anchors cover the shoulder and arm.
scenes.speak: Blue 3×3 anchors cover the shoulder and arm. Local warping fixes the posture.

scenes.context: 裤线刷修：100%缩放下圆形笔刷停在西裤膝后褶皱处。用笔刷处理裤子的褶皱细节，让面料干净挺括。
sentences: 笔刷停在西裤膝后褶皱处。
The brush pauses at the knee creases.
scenes.speak: The brush pauses at the knee creases. Retouching at 100% zoom.

scenes.context: 黑白检视：去色后回看新娘侧脸与头纱层次，圆形光标停在耳饰附近。去掉颜色，专门检查光影过渡是否均匀。
sentences: 去色后回看侧脸与头纱。
Desaturated, reviewing profile and veil layers.
黑白模式检查光影层次。
Black and white exposes the tonal layers.
scenes.speak: Desaturated, reviewing profile and veil layers. Black and white exposes the tonal layers.

scenes.context: 成片与调色对照：左右饱和度/色温差异明显，画面带修图服务水印。左边原片、右边成片，色温和饱和度差异明显。
sentences: 左右饱和度与色温差异明显。
Saturation and white balance clearly differ side by side.
The final frame carries the service watermark.
scenes.speak: Saturation and white balance clearly differ side by side. The final frame carries the service watermark.

practice: Trace the crown-to-forehead line to start a retouch.
Marching ants mark exactly where you'll edit.
A mesh and pins shape the body without global warping.
Desaturating exposes tonal problems color hides.
Grading side-by-side proves the retouch works.
pitfalls: Outline, select, and liquify come first.
Liquify the whole body at once.
Pinned local meshes keep it natural.
A black-and-white pass reveals tonal issues.
Side-by-side grading shows the true result.
100% zoom catches knee creases and seams.
shifts: 用 marching ants（蚂蚁线）、selection（选区）、local edit（局部处理）
用 desaturate（去色）、black-and-white check（黑白检视）、grade（调色）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播与图注。已校正：开场侧脸发顶到额头的勾勒线光标停在发际附近、天空选区不规则蚂蚁线落在蓝天区域准备做局部处理或填充、液化变形网格新娘全身三角网与钉点耳旁显示像素坐标与6.0度、西服选区蚂蚁线贴着夹克下摆与背景交界准备局部处理、肩部变形网格蓝色3×3锚点覆盖西装肩臂水印颜值修图可见、裤线刷修100%缩放下圆形笔刷停在西裤膝后褶皱处、黑白检视去色后回看新娘侧脸与头纱层次光标停在耳饰附近、成片与调色对照左右饱和度色温差异明显画面带修图服务水印。
